edges.label: same_fact
edges.reason: Both assertions are derived from the same Reuters X post. The existing one states "No plague cases detected in Siberia" and the new one notes "locals play down scare," both supporting the absence of cases. Since the shared origin is established by the evidence_id and source metadata but not explicit words in the quotes, I'll use an empty source span.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-06, Reuters reported “No plague cases detected in Siberia, Russia says”; on the same day, Reuters reported “locals play down scare”.
